value.message: Set up conversational interface (CI) product settings that will apply to both Virtual Agent and Agent Chat.
Choose how your chat client appears to users and where it can interact with them.
Determine how you want the chat client and chat experience to look depending on where it shows up.
Connect to third party messaging apps so your users have more ways to access VA.
Gather contextual information from the users so that you can decide how to best handle their request.
Collect contextual information (like device and location) about users who are interacting with the chat client.
Route your users to the right topic based on their response to survey questions, then map those questions to a context variable and store the responses.
Use Natural Language Understanding to decide what topic will be shown to the user based on a specific piece of contextual information.
Decide what happens after certain actions take place in the chat client.
Choose what messages appear in a conversation to notify the user changes or updates (like getting transferred to an agent).
Determine what happens when a user selects a link that goes to another ServiceNow interface (like a workspace or portal).
Decide what sensitive information to detect and how you want to mask it when it's shared unintentionally in a chat conversation.
